# Task evidence template

**Task:** TASK-XXX-YY
**Implementation status:** planned
**Evidence status:** not_run
**Source revision:** not recorded
**Environment/toolchain:** not recorded
**Implementer / independent reviewer:** not assigned

## Actual outcome

Record implemented capability and limits, including the predecessor/contract baseline and current [personal-tool applicability](../changes/2026-10-10-personal-tool-revision.md) and [directory-results applicability](../changes/2026-10-10-directory-results-revision.md). For viewer/auth/AI work, show useful html_js_v1, actual remembered access or actual provider permissions as applicable; no exhaustive threat/device certification is implied. Link a CI/PR artifact where it already holds this evidence; do not duplicate a narrative to satisfy a file count.

## Case evidence

| Task-local / inherited / supplemental case | Fixture or exact source target | Expected observable | Command or procedure | Actual result | Evidence location |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Not run | Not selected | Not recorded | Not run | not_run | None |

Distinguish initial feature proof from regression, real provider from fake, physical device from simulation, and process interruption from actual storage durability evidence. For directory/Reader changes, record file/page shape, actual byte/count workloads, complete round-trip identity and relevant X18–X20 outcomes; finite test workloads are not product quotas. Record `pass`, `fail`, `blocked` or `not_run` for each case under the execution protocol's evidence enum. Include the bounded contribution, unmet observable and next action; needs-rework is a reason for `fail`, not a separate status.

## Knowledge and user evidence, when applicable

Link the [knowledge-quality worksheet](../testing/knowledge-quality.md) with material claims, structural citation resolution, semantic support, predeclared expected reader answers/actions, observed outcomes and limits. Distinguish observed generation inputs from a post-hoc target check. Record a bounded repair and reconsideration trigger for a failed required reader outcome. Name the reader/evaluator role; do not call an agent-only run a human usability study.

## Contract, state and recovery effects

List affected schemas/API/config/examples, compatibility classification, migrations, exact version/page/optional region anchors and current authorization. Where relevant, identify operation fingerprint/preconditions, runtime_generation/auth_epoch/stream_epoch, attempt_generation and source/object pins. Record the tested recovery path and its trust boundary.

## Review and handoff

Apply the shared [definition of done](../execution-protocol.md). Record reviewer, decision, required-case status, residual issue IDs and exact next task. A recorded failure, missing real prerequisite or not_run gate prevents completion. All placeholders remain until actual evidence exists.
